independence: Reviewer authored execution capacity and holding-rule policy, but did not author the public-package generator or release boundary. This review concerns package contents and integrity, not independent approval of the reviewer's own implementation.
record_basis: Persisted once from the already-completed read-only inspection; no repeated tests or source acquisition for this receipt.

checks.name: patch_sensitive_field_references_inspected
checks.finding: References to window_observations, relevant_pages and first-page excerpts are executable generation or review code, not captured source payloads.

checks.name: readme_and_manifest_disclose_incomplete_source_reproducibility
checks.finding: README requires licensed local source objects and frozen admission artifacts; MANIFEST explicitly sets full_source_admission_reproducible_from_package_alone to false.

content_conclusion: No captured raw daily vendor price/amount observations, original PDF files, long original-source page extracts or private broker records were found in the inspected package. Included daily NAV/returns, product contributions and formation medians are derived research outputs. Full orders, fills, positions and source-admission evidence are intentionally local-only.

nonblocking_documentation_observations.finding_at_inspection: PUBLIC_RELEASE_BOUNDARY stated that the whitelist and per-file hashes were in PUBLIC_PACKAGE_RECEIPT. That receipt contains package and manifest hashes plus the file count; the actual whitelist and per-file hashes are inside the zip MANIFEST.json.
nonblocking_documentation_observations.disposition: Reported to root; root stated the boundary sentence would be clarified in the final receipt-only commit. This receipt does not assert the later wording was rechecked.

nonblocking_documentation_observations.finding_at_inspection: SUMMARY.md refers to ACCOUNT_PATHS and accounts/ complete ledgers, which are absent by design. README and LOCAL_AUDIT_POINTERS explicitly distinguish the local full audit and the public subset.
nonblocking_documentation_observations.disposition: No completeness blocker when package context is preserved; do not distribute SUMMARY alone as if the full ledger were included.

limitations: This is a content/integrity review, not a legal license or redistribution authorization opinion.
No network or remote-state check was performed; uploaded=false and the absence of a remote push are not independently proved by inspecting a local zip.
Byte identity checks do not independently establish historical claims that frozen artifacts were never modified; those claims require the separate immutable-artifact and execution receipts.

Source-excerpt comparison used normalized windows from long Chinese package lines against 330 saved source text files. It is bounded evidence, not a universal proof against every paraphrase, short quotation or omitted source.
The public package alone cannot reproduce source admission or reconstruct the full accounts without licensed local originals, frozen selection, configuration and admission evidence.
Account tests and simulations were not repeated. CSV counts, package hashes, source-content scans and byte equality checks are the scope of this review.
The recorded result-artifact commit was supplied by root; this receipt does not claim an additional commit-history audit.
